analysis_summary: This ontology models the social media discourse of 10,000 Portuguese students and related stakeholders evaluating AI educational tools (e.g., Magicbook/AiA) against national exam pressures and the private tutoring (explicações) market. It defines eight specific social actors spanning students across cycles, parents, teachers, private tutors, EdTech firms, schools, education authorities, and media outlets, followed by two universal fallback entities (Person, Organization).
